# ============================================================================
# Oracle Taleo career sections, one `host,section,portal` triple per line.
#
# NOTHING HERE IS REGISTERED, AND THERE IS NO taleo.go. This file exists to
# record a measured negative so the next person starts from the measurement
# rather than from docs/source-backlog.md's one-line "still missing".
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RE-MEASURED 2026-07-29. THE ANSWER IS STILL NO, FOR A DIFFERENT REASON.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# The section below headed "WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE ANSWER" set a two-part test:
# eight byte-identical requests must return the same count, AND that count must
# equal totalCount. Both halves were re-run on 2026-07-29, same body, same
# headers, pageSize 1000, 1.5s apart.
#
# The FIRST half now passes on four of the five tenants that answer:
#
#   host                  totalCount   items per request (x8)      union
#   molgroup.taleo.net    402          312 x8                      312
#   baesystems.taleo.net  162          143 x8                      143
#   stantec.taleo.net     184          127 x8                      127
#   wsp.taleo.net         204          174 x8                      174
#   ttec.taleo.net        111          25,25,25,25,25,25,110,25    110
#
# baesystems, stantec and wsp alternated between two counts on 2026-07-28 and
# are stable today; ttec still is not, and its unstable answer is the SMALL one
# seven times in eight. A ttec source registered today would have reported 25 of
# its 111 postings on seven of eight nightly crawls. That alone is the failure
# mode this project cares about most, and it has not gone away -- it has just
# moved to a different tenant, which is what "per tenant rather than
# platform-wide" predicted.
#
# The SECOND half fails on every tenant, and 2026-07-29 established why it is
# not a paging problem and cannot be worked around:
#
#   * the facets in the SAME response count the full totalCount. molgroup's
#     JOB_FIELD facet quantities sum to 402 and its JOB_SCHEDULE facet to 402
#     (Full-time 347 + Part-time 55), while requisitionList holds 312. A
#     response whose own facets disagree with its own list is truncating the
#     list, not describing a smaller board.
#   * slicing by a facet does not recover the missing rows. Requesting molgroup
#     with JOB_SCHEDULE=Full-time answers totalCount 347 and 280 items;
#     JOB_SCHEDULE=Part-time answers totalCount 55 and 32 items. The two slices
#     union to exactly 312 -- the same 312 -- so the 90 missing requisitions are
#     unreachable through this endpoint by any query tried.
#   * a pageNo walk does not help either, and now for a plainer reason than the
#     drift recorded below: at pageSize=100 the server answered pageNo=1 with
#     312 items, then 100, 96 and 25 on pages 2-4, unioning to the same 312. It
#     ignores the pageSize it is given on the first page and honours it after.
#   * sorting ascending instead of descending returns the same 312 (0 new ids).
#
# So the best available read of a Taleo career section is 69-88% of the number
# that section's own API states, with the shortfall unexplained and no query
# that closes it. Registering it would put four employers into the crawl each
# reporting a fraction of itself, with a totalCount field sitting right there in
# the response proving the fraction is wrong.
#
# Kaiser Permanente, the employer docs/source-backlog.md names for this
# platform, was re-checked on 2026-07-29 and is unchanged: kp.taleo.net answers,
# /careersection/external/jobsearch.ftl still 302s to mysubmissions.ftl, and all
# three portal ids known to this file answer careerSectionUnAvailable:true.
#
# What would change the answer NOW is narrower than what this file asked for on
# 2026-07-28: find one tenant where len(requisitionList) == totalCount on eight
# identical requests. Until then the endpoint's own arithmetic says it is
# lying, and an honest "not covered" beats a source that reports 77% of an
# employer and looks healthy doing it.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT WORKS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# The keyless JSON endpoint docs/research/ats-platform-survey.md describes is
# real, and it answered on 2026-07-28:
#
#   POST https://{host}/careersection/rest/jobboard/searchjobs?lang=en&portal={portal}
#   headers: Content-Type: application/json, tz: GMT+00:00, tzname: UTC
#   body:    {"multilineEnabled":false,
#             "sortingSelection":{"sortBySelectionParam":"3","ascendingSortingOrder":"false"},
#             "fieldData":{"fields":{"KEYWORD":"","LOCATION":""},"valid":true},
#             "filterSelectionParam":{"searchFilterSelections":[]},
#             "advancedSearchFiltersSelectionParam":{"searchFilterSelections":[]},
#             "pageNo":1,"pageSize":1000}
#   ->       {"requisitionList":[...],"pagingData":{"currentPageNo":1,
#             "pageSize":1000,"totalCount":402},"careerSectionUnAvailable":false}
#
# Three details the survey does not have, all measured:
#
#   * `portal` is mandatory. Omitting it, or sending a wrong one, answers
#     HTTP 200 with {"requisitionList":null,...,"careerSectionUnAvailable":true}
#     -- a live-looking 200 for a board you cannot read.
#   * `currentPageNo` and `currentRecordCount` in the body, which the survey's
#     example includes, are REJECTED: the server answers HTTP 400 with the body
#     "An Error Occurred in TEE". Only `pageNo` and `pageSize` are accepted.
#   * the per-posting `column` array is positional and its layout is per tenant
#     -- molgroup emits [title, locations, date] and baesystems emits [title]
#     alone -- but the response says which is which: `linkedColumn` is the index
#     of the title and `locationsColumns` is the list of location indices. An
#     adapter does not have to guess.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHY IT IS NOT REGISTERED: THE SAME REQUEST RETURNS A DIFFERENT BOARD
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Eight byte-identical requests per tenant, 1.5s apart, pageSize 1000:
#
#   host                  totalCount   items returned per request        union
#   molgroup.taleo.net    402          312 x8                            312
#   baesystems.taleo.net  183          164,25,25,164,164,164,164,164     164
#   stantec.taleo.net     184          127,100,127,100,127,100,100,127   127
#   wsp.taleo.net         205          100,100,175,100,100,175,175,175   175
#
# Each short response is a strict PREFIX of the long one -- verified on
# molgroup, where a 16-item response was the first 16 items of the 91-item
# response for the same request -- and each is well-formed JSON, so this is the
# server truncating the list, not a transport cutting the stream. The truncation
# lands on round numbers (25, 100) that look like a career section's own
# configured page size, so the likeliest explanation is a load-balanced pair of
# app nodes that disagree about whether the requested pageSize applies.
#
# Consequence for this project: a Taleo source would report 25 postings one
# night and 164 the next for a board that did not change. That is the failure
# mode this codebase cares about most -- a source that quietly reports a
# fraction -- and it is worse than not having the platform, because the number
# looks fine.
#
# Paging around it does not help. Walking molgroup with pageNo=1..N returned
# 91,100,96,25 at pageSize=100 (312 unique) and 91,25,96,25 at pageSize=25 (187
# unique) in two walks minutes apart: pages 2 and 4 changed size between walks,
# so a pageNo walk skips postings whenever the server's idea of a page differs
# from the client's.
#
# And even the best answer is short. molgroup's union of 312 is 22% below its
# own totalCount of 402, and the gap is NOT multi-location rows: expanding every
# requisition's locationsColumns gives 312 requisition-location rows, the same
# number.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE OTHER BLOCKER: DISCOVERY
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# There is no published Taleo tenant list of the kind that exists for iCIMS and
# Avature, and both halves of a tenant key have to be discovered:
#
#   * the host. A DNS sweep of 8,010 company names already in this registry
#     against {name}.taleo.net returned 27 hits (nonexistent names fail DNS, so
#     there is no wildcard inflating that). Common Crawl reportedly sees ~286
#     tenants per snapshot, so a name sweep finds under 10% of the platform.
#   * the portal id. It is a per-tenant number that is not in any URL a person
#     would have. It CAN be read off the career section page -- it is in
#     `queryString: 'lang=en&portal=NNNN'` inside the
#     fs/FacetedSearchSettings require config on
#     https://{host}/careersection/{section}/jobsearch.ftl?lang=en -- but the
#     section name is itself per tenant and not guessable. Probing 29 hosts
#     against 31 candidate section names found a portal for 4.
#
# Two portal ids recur across unrelated tenants (101430233 serves baesystems,
# stantec and wsp), which suggests a shared default worth trying before probing
# section names, but it is not universal: it answers careerSectionUnAvailable
# for att, axa, hilton, kp, munichre, tenet and westpac.
#
# Kaiser Permanente, the employer docs/source-backlog.md names for this
# platform, is no longer reachable this way. kp.taleo.net exists, but
# /careersection/external/jobsearch.ftl 302s to mysubmissions.ftl (a login wall)
# and publishes no portal id, and every portal tried answers
# careerSectionUnAvailable. Their public board is now www.kaiserpermanentejobs.org.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT WOULD CHANGE THE ANSWER
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Re-run the eight-identical-requests measurement above. If a tenant returns the
# same count eight times AND that count equals totalCount, this endpoint has
# become trustworthy for that tenant and the adapter is a short one: single
# request, pageSize above totalCount, decode `column` through `linkedColumn` and
# `locationsColumns`, posting URL
# https://{host}/careersection/{section}/jobdetail.ftl?job={jobId}&lang=en.
# molgroup was stable across all eight, so this may be per tenant rather than
# platform-wide -- the same shape #35 found for Eightfold's authorization wall.
#
# Pacing when it lands: *.taleo.net is one vendor backend, so it wants a shared
# limiter key like *.icims.com, not a per-tenant one.
#
# Format below: host,section,portal  # measured
# ============================================================================
molgroup.taleo.net,external,8205100397    # MOL Group. 2026-07-29: totalCount 402, 312 items on 8 of 8 identical requests
baesystems.taleo.net,2,101430233          # BAE Systems. 2026-07-29: totalCount 162, 143 items on 8 of 8 (no longer alternating; was 25/164 on 2026-07-28)
stantec.taleo.net,,101430233              # Stantec. 2026-07-29: totalCount 184, 127 items on 8 of 8 (was 100/127). Section name not found; portal works without one. NOTE: "stantec" is already registered on oracle_orc (hdhl.fa.us6.oraclecloud.com,CX_1), so this tenant needs a double_count verdict before it is ever registered
wsp.taleo.net,us,101430233                # WSP. 2026-07-29: totalCount 204, 174 items on 8 of 8 (was 100/175)
ttec.taleo.net,2,160131726                # TTEC. 2026-07-29: totalCount 111, returned 25 on 7 of 8 requests and 110 on the eighth. Still the disqualifying tenant
westpac.taleo.net,2,160140091             # Westpac. totalCount 3, returned 0 postings on 3 of 3 requests
jacobs.taleo.net,ex,101430233             # Jacobs. Answers, totalCount 0. Not evidence of anything either way
